position_overview: In this pivotal role, you'll provide comprehensive administrative support to our recruitment team. You'll play an essential part in sourcing candidates, managing our CRM, overseeing job advertising, coordinating interviews, and supporting our marketing efforts. Your contribution will be vital in ensuring a seamless recruitment process and delivering excellent service to our clients and candidates. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Recruitment Administration - Source candidates using our recruitment database, LinkedIn, and online job boards - Build and manage talent pools for current and future vacancies - Screen applications and match them to role requirements - Distribute and follow up screening questionnaires - Coordinate phone and video interviews - Prepare candidate summaries and profiles for recruiters and client presentations - Format resumes into company-branded templates - Track interview feedback, offer stages, and start dates CRM & Database Management - Maintain accurate candidate and vacancy records - Update candidate employment history, availability, and contact details - Tag, categorise, and clean up database records - Re-engage existing talent within our database - Monitor recruitment pipelines and vacancy stages Job Advertising - Create and publish engaging job advertisements - Update and refresh active job ads - Monitor application workflows and prepare weekly advertising reports - Maintain a clear active job advertisement register Calendar & Inbox Management - Monitor inboxes and respond to candidate enquiries - Schedule and confirm interviews and meetings - Maintain recruiter calendars and task lists Compliance Support - Coordinate reference checks and manage candidate documentation - Track outstanding compliance requirements - Ensure confidential storage of sensitive information Marketing Support - Create and schedule social media content and simple Canva graphics - Assist with newsletters, email campaigns, and updating website job listings - Research new clients and update CRM records ABOUT YOU You are: - Highly organised, process-driven, and detail-oriented - Self-motivated and able to work independently - Professional, friendly, and confident in candidate communications - Effective at juggling multiple priorities - Passionate about recruitment and excellent service delivery ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS - Previous experience in Recruitment Administration,
